reference: His flatmate asked him why he spent two hours a day just to sit at a desk.
sk: Spolubývajúci sa ho spýtal, prečo trávi dve hodiny denne len na to, aby sedel za stolom.
cz: Spolubydlící se ho zeptal, proč tráví dvě hodiny denně jen kvůli tomu, aby seděl u stolu.
acceptable: His {flatmate|roommate|housemate} asked {him |}why he spent two hours a day {just|only} {to sit|sitting} at {a|his|the} desk.
His {flatmate|roommate|housemate} asked {him |}why he spent two hours {every day|per day} {just|only} {to sit|sitting} at {a|his} desk.
His {flatmate|roommate} asked {him |}why he was spending two hours a day {just|only} {to sit|sitting} at {a|his} desk.

mistakes.text: His {flatmate|roommate} asked him why {did he spend|does he spend} two hours a day just to sit at a desk.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V nepriamej otázke je slovosled ako v oznamovacej vete, bez „did/does“: „why he spent“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V nepřímé otázce je slovosled jako v oznamovací větě, bez „did/does“: „why he spent“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In a reported question use statement word order, without “did/does”: “why he spent”.

mistakes.text: His {flatmate|roommate} asked him why he spends two hours a day just to sit at a desk.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Reported speech sa po „asked“ Present Simple zvyčajne posúva do Past Simple: „spent“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V Reported speech se po „asked“ Present Simple obvykle posouvá do Past Simple: „spent“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In Reported speech after “asked”, the Present Simple usually moves back to the Past Simple: “spent”.

mistakes.text: His {flatmate|roommate} asked him why do you spend two hours a day just to sit at a desk.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Treba Reported speech: „why he spent“, nie priamu otázku „why do you spend“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Je potřeba Reported speech: „why he spent“, ne přímou otázku „why do you spend“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Report the question: “why he spent”, not the direct question “why do you spend”.

mistakes.text: His {flatmate|roommate} asked him why he spent two hours a day just for sitting at a desk.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Účel („aby“) vyjadruje „to + sloveso“: „just to sit“, nie „for sitting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Účel („aby“) vyjadřuje „to + sloveso“: „just to sit“, ne „for sitting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: To show purpose use “to + verb”: “just to sit”, not “for sitting”.

mistakes.text: His {flatmate|roommate} asked {to him|from him} why he spent two hours a day just to sit at a desk.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „ask“ nasleduje osoba priamo, bez predložky: „asked him“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „ask“ následuje osoba přímo, bez předložky: „asked him“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Ask” takes the person directly, with no preposition: “asked him”.
